753:t_105:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$オックス$$! We'll use your power to save the universe!」

753:t_106:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「So the son of darkness incarnate is fighting alongside them.」

753:t_106:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
「$$正太郎$$ and $c saved me from the darkness.」

753:t_106:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But you must atone.」

753:t_106:3.en:
$$グーラ$$
「You don't have to tell me! And I've already decided how!」

753:t_106:4.en:
$$グーラ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$, you falsely claim God's name! I'll defeat you, even if it costs my life!」

753:t_106:5.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I'll stake my life to protect this universe's future!!」

753:t_107:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$甲児$$... Having become one with Photon Power, you may someday attain $$シンカ$$ and become a higher-dimensional being.」

753:t_107:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「But to do that, I have to defeat you and save this universe!」

753:t_107:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「There is no need. Above all, I will not permit you to attain $$シンカ$$ when you reject my salvation.」

753:t_107:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Don't screw with me! What gives you the right to decide that?!」

753:t_107:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is what God is! I surpassed the $$御使い$$s with the resolve to bear that responsibility!」

753:t_107:5.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then I'll show you my resolve too!」

753:t_107:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「To defeat you, our greatest, strongest enemy, I'll become one with $$マジンガー$$ and draw out all its power!!」

753:t_107:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Even then, you will not reach God.」

753:t_107:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「I won't accept your verdict! $$マジンガーＺ$$ and I will become a Demon God beyond gods and devils!」

753:t_107:9.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's a showdown, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! The Demon God of Light will protect this universe!!」

753:t_108:0.en:
$$さやか$$
「I'm part of $c too! Even if we're up against God...!」

753:t_108:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「How brave, $$さやか$$. Do you find joy in fighting alongside your beloved $$甲児$$?」

753:t_108:2.en:
$$さやか$$
「That's not all! I'm fighting because I can't stand your existence!」

753:t_108:3.en:
$$さやか$$
「I'm not just $$甲児$$'s sidekick! I'll defeat you as a warrior in my own right!」

753:t_108:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「What a shame. You reject me too.」

753:t_108:5.en:
$$さやか$$
「Since this is the end, I'll say it! Just looking at that smile like you know everything makes me sick!」

753:t_108:6.en:
$$さやか$$
「Here I come, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Get ready!!」

753:t_109:0.en:
$$ヌケ$$
「B-$$ボス$$! W-we're up against God!」

753:t_109:1.en:
$$ムチャ$$
「And he's freaking huge! We can't fight him in $$ボロット$$!」

753:t_109:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「They know their place.」

753:t_109:3.en:
$$ボス$$
「Shut up! A real man breaks past those limits!」

753:t_109:5.en:
$$クロス$$
「You showed us what kind of man you are right at the very end.」

753:t_109:8.en:
$$お菊$$
「Then let's go. We haven't got any time left.」

753:t_109:9.en:
$$ボス$$
「Make up your minds, $$ヌケ$$, $$ムチャ$$! This is our last chance to shine!」

753:t_109:10.en:
$$ボス$$
「Let's do it! We'll show him even small fry like us can get things done if we try!」

753:t_110:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Our battle will be this universe's final True War.」

753:t_110:1.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「It was arrogant to think a battle between higher-dimensional beings could decide the universe's future.」

753:t_110:2.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Look, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Every life in the universe is trying to move toward the future!」

753:t_110:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「What a shame. It seems the universe could not wait for that.」

753:t_110:4.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「That resignation will destroy the universe! One who yields to fate does not deserve the name of God!」

753:t_110:5.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「I too renounce the name of God! I have chosen to risk my life and fight alongside them for the future!」

753:t_110:6.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Prepare yourself, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! My power of light will strike down your self-righteousness!!」

753:t_111:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「It is over, $$竜馬$$. Your journey of battle ends here.」

753:t_111:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Quit joking. My fight will go on even after I beat you.」

753:t_111:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Living is fighting! As long as I'm alive, I'll fight!」

753:t_111:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You are fundamentally mistaken.」

753:t_111:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your life ends here. That is what I mean when I say your fight is over.」

753:t_111:5.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're a phony god after all. That prophecy's wrong.」

753:t_111:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We'll defeat you right here! That's not a prophecy. It's my declaration!」

753:t_111:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I cannot allow you to speak to me like that!」

753:t_111:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Did I make you mad? Good!」

753:t_111:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Come at me with everything, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We'll win the universe's greatest, final battle!!」

753:t_112:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「So another one chosen by the $$ゲッター線$$ is here.」

753:t_112:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「Are you saying I'm the same as $$竜馬$$?」

753:t_112:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$隼人$$... You too seem not to understand your destiny. That must be humanity's limitation.」

753:t_112:3.en:
$$隼人$$
「Can you afford to keep pontificating, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$? You'll never keep up with my supersonic world like that.」

753:t_112:5.en:
$$隼人$$
「I'm not putting up with your bullshit! I'll settle this quickly!」

753:t_112:6.en:
$$隼人$$
「The whole universe is waiting for our victory!!」

753:t_113:0.en:
$$弁慶$$
「The fate of the whole universe rides on this showdown! We absolutely can't lose!」

753:t_113:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Only I have the right to use the word 'absolutely.' You should learn that too.」

753:t_113:2.en:
$$弁慶$$
「You sure about that? If you lose to us after all that big talk, you'll be humiliated, self-proclaimed God!」

753:t_113:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That will not happen. Absolutely!」

753:t_113:5.en:
$$弁慶$$
「The $$大雪山おろし$$ $$武蔵$$ taught me can throw even a god! Feel it for yourself!!」

753:t_114:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$マーズ$$... No, $$タケル$$... The time has come for your love to be rewarded.」

753:t_114:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「The universe's collapse is salvation that comes equally to all life. There is no conflict, inequality or poverty in it.」

753:t_114:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「And I shall make the new universe a world overflowing with light.」

753:t_114:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「I don't have time for your delusions!」

753:t_114:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I thought you, who fight for love, would understand me.」

753:t_114:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「Your love isn't for anyone else! It's directed only at yourself!」

753:t_114:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「Your salvation is hypocrisy that forces your selfish good intentions on others! We won't lose to someone like you!」

753:t_114:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Light and darkness have fused into one...! You challenge me with that power!」

753:t_114:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「I'll fight in $$ゴッドマーズ$$ for all the love that brought me here, and for everything I love!」

753:t_114:10.en:
$$タケル$$
「That's what my psychic powers are for...! That's the meaning of my life!!」

753:t_115:1.en:
$$アキラ$$
「I'm counting on you to attack, $$ナオト$$!」
